localChanges: A goody hut far from any city can now unleash a horde of barbarians. Near a city, or before you have one, you get mercenaries as before (closes #172).

Killing a barbarian leader pays 100 gold ransom, even when he was stacked with his raiders. Horsemen and Musketmen that take a city burn it, while stronger barbarians capture it. Their mounted and gunpowder raiders wreck irrigation and mines near your cities, and a leader left on his own eventually gives up (closes #171).
